feature_notes: Notes parsing recognizes headings 'new features'/'new' -> New, 'bug fixes'/'fixes'/'bugs' -> Bugs, 'refinements'/'improvements' -> Refinements, case-insensitively, bare or wrapped in #-heading or **bold** chrome, with trailing ':' stripped
Bullet markers accepted: '-', U+2010, U+2013, U+2014, U+2212, '*', '•', each followed by a space or tab
Lines that are empty, '---', or start with '<' are skipped entirely
Any other heading (for example 'Thanks to contributors') closes the current section so its bullets are dropped
Bullets are de-duplicated case-insensitively per section, keeping the first occurrence

A last bullet containing the word 'extra' preceded by a number becomes the section's rollup, its number counts toward changeCount but it renders in the tertiary style below the bullets (example shape: "Fixed 12 extra issues…")
Inline Markdown stripped from bullets: [text](url) -> text, **text** -> text, `text` -> text, then whitespace trimmed
Notes in any other shape produce an empty digest and the page falls back to rendering the raw notes as Markdown
parse(_:) memoizes on the raw string so re-evaluations of the About page do not re-run three regexes per bullet

The progress head only moves forward: a lower target snaps down immediately, a higher one is chased exponentially with dt clamped to 0.25s, step at least minimumSpeed*dt, and snaps once within 0.0001 of the target
Chase response: 0.15 under reduceMotion, 0.72 while phase == .celebrating, otherwise 0.3; minimumSpeed 0.12 while celebrating else 0
Frame clock pauses when the head is settled or while ScrollActivity.shared.isScrolling; the sparkle canvas also pauses when sparkles are empty

The pill shows the slider whenever progress.showsProgressUI, otherwise the Update & restart button when checker.updateAvailable && checker.update != nil && !showsProgressUI, otherwise the standing seal
The seal distinguishes 'Check failed' (lastError != nil) and 'Not checked yet' (lastCheckedAt == nil) from 'Up to date', so it no longer claims up-to-date before a successful check
Opening the About page runs checker.check(); if progress.consumePendingCelebration() is true it runs the post-relaunch sweep

Celebration sweep: sleep 550ms, bail unless phase == .celebrating, finishCelebrationSweep(), then under reduceMotion one .alignment haptic + 900ms, else 900ms, .alignment haptic, 450ms, .levelChange haptic, 700ms, then completeCelebration()
Leaving the page mid-sweep cancels the task and calls completeCelebration() so the pill lands on Up to date immediately
Release detail joins with " · ": "Released <long date>", the file-style byte count, and always "Update & restart installs it in place and relaunches."

Check row detail: "Asking GitLab for the latest release…" while checking; otherwise "<error> Checked <relative>." on error, "Droppy Code <version> is ready to install. Checked <relative>." when an update waits, else "Droppy Code checks GitLab for new versions a few times a day. Checked <relative>."; when never checked the suffix is "Not checked yet."
Update distribution is GitLab releases of a signed and notarized disk image

feature_notes: Ready recipes are those HydraCookbook.resolve returns a HydraPair for; waiting recipes are those HydraCookbook.missingProvider returns a ProviderKind for; both lists keep HydraCookbook.recipes order
A ready row's title comes from HydraPairSummary.title of the resolved pair (so it names the actual models), a waiting row falls back to recipe.title
The pair mark for a waiting recipe shows the recipe's first-choice providers (recipe.lead.providers.first / recipe.heads.providers.first), defaulting to .claude if the recipe lists none

The detail line joins with " · ": the providers line "<lead.displayName> lead, <heads.displayName> heads" only when headsProvider != provider, plus HydraPairSummary.efforts; when both are absent the line is omitted entirely so the row has no blank space

Installs a local NSEvent keyDown monitor that swallows Escape (keyCode 53) while the panel is visible and closes it; removed on close
NSOpenPanel.runModal() for .path fields - a modal file/folder chooser
model.mcp.setDraft(...) writes the draft credential value; model.mcp.connect(entry) starts the connection (and for OAuth entries a browser sign-in)
platform_assumptions: AppKit NSPanel with styleMask [.nonactivatingPanel, .fullSizeContentView, .titled, .closable], .floating level, hidesOnDeactivate = false, collectionBehavior [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]

Standard window buttons (close, miniaturize, zoom) hidden explicitly; titleVisibility .hidden, titlebarAppearsTransparent, isMovableByWindowBackground, isOpaque = false, backgroundColor .clear, hasShadow = true
NSHostingView fittingSize used to measure the SwiftUI content height before sizing the panel
NSScreen.main?.visibleFrame and bottom-left origin coordinates for placement
macOS key code 53 = Escape
NSWorkspace for opening URLs, NSOpenPanel for file/folder selection
.buttonStyle(.glassProminent) (macOS 26 Liquid Glass)
WindowBackdrop / WindowDragArea are NSViewRepresentable-style macOS window helpers
persisted_fields: None written directly here; the draft values go through model.mcp.setDraft and are persisted by the MCP model (secrets presumably in its own store, not visible from this file)
ui_elements: Panel size: 380 wide; height measured from the hosting view's fittingSize rounded up, with a floor of 100; initial contentRect 380x200
Placement: x = visibleFrame.maxX - 380 - 24, y = visibleFrame.maxY - panel.frame.height - 24 (top-right with a 24pt margin)

Content: VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14), .padding(18), .frame(width: 380), clipped to RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Chrome.windowCornerRadius, style: .continuous), backed by WindowDragArea then WindowBackdrop(opacity: 0.5)

Header: MCPIcon(entry:size: 26), entry.name at .system(size: 14, weight: .semibold), subtitle "Connect" at .system(size: 11), Spacer(minLength: 8), close button "xmark" at .system(size: 11, weight: .semibold) in Chrome.secondaryText, HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10)
Steps with keysURL: 1 "The page is open in your browser" with Link "Open it again" at .system(size: 11); 2 "Copy the <first field label lowercased, else 'key'>"; 3 "Paste it below and save"
Steps without keysURL: 1 "Enter the <first field label lowercased, else 'value'>"; 2 "Sign in in your browser" when entry.isOAuth else "Save"

Step badge: Circle filled Chrome.accent.opacity(0.18) at 18x18 with the number at .system(size: 10, weight: .semibold) in Chrome.accent; row HStack(spacing: 8), text HStack(spacing: 4) at .system(size: 12); steps VStack spacing 6

Field: label .system(size: 11, weight: .semibold) in Chrome.secondaryText; editor .system(size: 12, design: .monospaced), .textFieldStyle(.plain), .focusEffectDisabled(); container .padding(.horizontal, 8)/.vertical 7 over RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 8, style: .continuous) filled Chrome.overlay(0.06); VStack spacing 5, inner HStack spacing 6
Path fields add a "folder" button at .system(size: 12) in Chrome.secondaryText
Field help text at .system(size: 10.5) in Chrome.secondaryText when non-empty
Primary button: "Sign in" when entry.isOAuth else "Save and connect", .buttonStyle(.glassProminent), disabled unless model.mcp.canConnect(entry), right-aligned behind a Spacer
feature_notes: Presenting the panel opens entry.keysURL in the default browser first, so the provider's key page sits beside the panel
The panel instance is reused: a second present() swaps contentViewController and resizes rather than creating a new NSPanel
Escape closes the panel and the key event is swallowed (returns nil) only while the panel is visible; otherwise the event passes through
The panel has no traffic lights; it closes from its own xmark button or Escape
The whole background is a drag area so the panel can be moved off the browser window that just opened
The first field gets focus on appear (focusedField = entry.fields.first?.key)
Pressing Return (.onSubmit) saves when model.mcp.canConnect(entry)
The panel closes itself when model.mcp.state(for: entry.id).isConnected turns true, which is how an OAuth sign-in completing dismisses it
save() calls model.mcp.connect(entry) and immediately calls onDone()
Path picking is entry-specific: for entry.id == "filesystem" the open panel chooses directories only; every other entry chooses files only; multiple selection is off in both cases
unresolved_questions: @Environment(AppModel.self) private var envModel is declared but never read in this file - it appears to be dead/vestigial, though the environment is still injected in present() via .environment(model)
Where MCP secrets ultimately land (Keychain vs a settings file) is decided by model.mcp.connect/setDraft, which is outside this bundle
Chrome.windowCornerRadius's numeric value and WindowBackdrop / WindowDragArea implementations are defined elsewhere
